catalogue.sentence: A quiet run is weak evidence: in Carbon Mapper's catalogue (897 cells; all instruments, unqualified passes) the pass after three non-detections still saw a plume 22 % of the time (47/210, 95 % CI 17–29 %), and the passes after longer quiet runs saw one 19–24 % of the time. That is why the refund is capped at the rebate, paid in installments, and cancelled by the next attested detection.

steps.text: Open the UNEP MARS record of the source (MARS data portal) and note its persistency category and the date of MARS's last plume.
Find the Carbon Mapper sources within 1.5 km of the MARS point in the Carbon Mapper data portal.
List every Carbon Mapper pass since MARS's last plume, with plume / no plume.
Compare dates: note the most recent quantified plume after the label, its date, rate and uncertainty.
Write the bundle fields, canonicalise them by the published RFC 8785 steps, compute SHA-256 and compare it with the attested evidenceHash.

verification.question: did a quantified plume reappear after the MARS label, and is the attested evidence exactly what the observers signed?
